title: Find why Genlock.app burns ~80% CPU and bring it down

fields.why: Measured 2026-11-13: Genlock.app (pid 48819, up 6h24m) averaged 81% CPU over 5 top samples, the top consumer on TJ's 2019 Intel MacBook Pro (load avg ~8). Local overhead, not dev work.

text: While measuring for a remote-dev cost model, Genlock.app was the top CPU user (~80% sustained, 6h+ uptime), above WindowServer (~40%, maybe terminal-pane rendering). Unconfirmed suspects: polling timers (channels, sessions.json, transcripts, tells), pane rendering, voice. Run 'sample <pid> 10' or Instruments to find the hot stack before changing code. Sources: app/Sources; check genlock claims first. Relaunch in background only (open -g).
